decisions.decision: Separate GAAP net income from adjusted operating measures and crypto investment fair-value gains.
decisions.reason: $718.697M GAAP net income included $715.022M net gains on crypto assets held for investment; adjusted net income was $77.7M.

decisions.decision: Treat $22B average USDC platform balance and $306.905M Q3 stablecoin revenue as stablecoin economics, not XRP demand.
decisions.reason: Neither metric identifies XRP purchases, XRP collateral balances or XRP settlement volume.

decisions.decision: Keep Circle's $36T USDC volume and 77% June stablecoin-volume share as issuer-reported aggregate metrics.
decisions.reason: These do not establish unique payments, net settlement, XRPL-specific volume or XRP demand.

decisions.decision: Add $100M equity investment and five-year USDC distribution agreement as a direct Circle-Binance edge and only an indirect XRP-market connection.
decisions.reason: SEC 8-K ties incentives to USDC held through Circle wallet infrastructure; it does not mention XRP.

decisions.decision: Treat Permission Coin ASK as strongest candidate, not an exclusive resolution of the original phrase.
decisions.reason: Official contracts list Base and Polygon LayerZero OFT-20 deployments; Coinbase partnership is embedded-wallet infrastructure, not an exchange listing; no XRPL contract is listed.

decisions.decision: Keep Tokyo SBIC separate from SBI Holdings, SBI Ripple Asia and SBI VC Trade.
decisions.reason: Official profile identifies its own corporate number; ChatGPT course was for investee companies and delivered by VOST.

decisions.decision: Preserve TradRadar 16:10 UTC observation as provider-specific descriptive data only.
decisions.reason: Seven-exchange OI and five-exchange liquidation coverage differ from Liqwall; no cross-provider delta is admitted.

decisions.decision: Do not issue a directional XRP forecast from these relationships or one derivatives snapshot.
decisions.reason: No point-in-time feature history, matched event-study baseline or out-of-sample calibrated model supports a probability.
